column1: # HSK1 vocabulary — the level-1 word table of the national standard.
# source: 《国际中文教育中文水平等级标准》(GF 0025-2021) 6.1 一级词汇表, entries 1-500
# source: http://www.moe.gov.cn/jyb_sjzl/ziliao/A19/202111/W020211118507389477190.pdf
# This is the transcription of record: number, the word as the table prints it,
# and the pinyin column as the table prints it. hsk1.txt is derived from this
# file and pipeline/tests/test_wordlist_hsk1.py asserts the two agree, so a
# correction belongs here and is then regenerated with `make wordlist`.
# Notation, kept as printed:
#   爸爸|爸      two accepted forms
#   白（形）     part of speech; 第（第二）and 子（桌子）are examples, not forms
#   有（一）些   an optional element inside the word: both forms are words
#   好玩ㄦ       commonly said with erhua
#   帮忙 bāng//máng   a separable verb
#   出来 chū/·lái     a neutral-tone option
# Transcribed from the scanned PDF, which carries no text layer. Two machine
# checks stand behind it: the numbering must run 1-500 unbroken, and every
# row's characters must agree with its own pinyin column under pypinyin —
# two independently read columns confirming each other. 47 rows differ only in
# neutral tone (爸爸 bàba against the dictionary form bàbà), which the check
# allows; no row disagreed on a character.
